reason: Start assembling the digestive system by connecting the salivary glands to the mouth.
expectation: The glands will fill their named slot on the digestive tube, with ducts opening into the mouth.

alternatives.reason: Starting starch digestion also fits the goal, but I prefer to connect an organ first.

effect: The salivary glands are fitted; the pancreas and liver remain to be connected.
reaction: The fitting was straightforward, with little new detail.
reason: Continue assembling the digestive tube by connecting the pancreas.
expectation: The pancreas will fill its named slot, connecting by its duct to the small intestine.

effect: The pancreas is fitted; the liver and gallbladder remain available for assembly.
reaction: Another straightforward fitting, without additional detail.
reason: Continue assembling the digestive system by fitting the liver and gallbladder.
expectation: They will fill their named slot, with bile ducts leading toward the intestine.

effect: The gland and organ assembly goal is complete; digestion remains.
reaction: The summary usefully connects each organ to its secretion.
reason: Begin breaking down the meal with starch and salivary amylase.
expectation: Amylase will begin breaking starch into smaller carbohydrates, though further digestion may be needed.

effect: Salivary amylase produced shorter starch chains, which can now undergo further digestion.
reaction: The intermediate makes the staged breakdown clear.
reason: Continue starch digestion with the pancreatic and intestinal enzymes.
expectation: The shorter chains will be broken into absorbable sugars, possibly after further steps.

effect: Starch digestion has produced individual glucose molecules; protein and fat digestion remain.
reaction: The progression from chains to glucose is clear.
reason: Continue breaking down the meal by applying the protein-digesting enzymes.
expectation: The protein chains will be broken into smaller peptides or amino acids.

effect: Protein digestion has produced amino acids; fat digestion remains.
reaction: The direct conversion is clear, though it skips intermediate peptides.
reason: Use the remaining offered combination to digest the fat.
expectation: Bile will disperse the fat into smaller droplets, allowing lipase to break it into absorbable products.
